visual_name: Day in the life, part thirty nine: still a twelve (low-poly 3D)
code_name: three.js karaoke booth (cut away at the front: confetti carpet, purple walls with pink and cyan neon, a wall screen drawn every frame with bouncing lyrics and a SCORE, a velvet couch, a coffee table with drinks, a disco ball), a ring light on a tripod with her phone and a REC dot, three box-built strangers who cover their ears, box-built creator with a purple bob and bangs, star earrings, a denim jacket over a yellow tee, black jeans, a mic and a teal can, phone sheets for her takes (TAKE 1 um…, TAKE 2 with a 4:02 cousin timer, TAKE 17 'Thanks, Bravo!' corrected to Brivo) / the UGC Script Generator (Hook, Body beats, App / product moment, CTA) / the karaoke score rolling to 98 with stars and confetti, hard cuts on voiceover word times
summary: A 41 second 9:16 reel in low-poly 3D: in a karaoke booth, she can sing in front of strangers, badly and loudly, but the second the camera is on she forgets English: take one, um; take two, four minutes about her cousin; take seventeen, the brand name wrong twice. Then YourBrand: the UGC Script Generator writes the hook, the beats and the product moment; she knows what to say and says it, first take. The karaoke machine scored the ad a 98. Her singing is still a 12.
